usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-2/generate with JSON body {prompt, size?, quality?} (x402 pay). Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX auth until status==="complete".
usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId (+ body.status="pending"). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} returns body.status, body.progress, and on completion body.result.imageUrl (the PNG URL).
quirks: Registry priceDisplay says $10.00 and paymentAccepts amount is 10000000 (10 USDC), but the LIVE x402 quote was only $0.01 — it paid fine well under the $6 cap. Do NOT skip as over-cap.
ASYNC: POST only pays + enqueues, returning {success, jobId, status:'pending', type}. No image in the POST response.
Poll endpoint is GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (note: /api/jobs/, NOT /api/status/ or /api/generate/...). This URL is NOT in the registry; derive it from the jobId.

The poll endpoint requires SIWX authentication (returns 402 'SIWX authentication required' with accepts:[] and a sign-in-with-x extension if unauthenticated). It is FREE (no x402 payment) once signed in.
Job took ~23s to go pending->complete; one poll after generation was enough here.
Result image is hosted on Vercel blob storage (public.blob.vercel-storage.com); body.result.imageUrl is a live public PNG (verified 200, image/png, 835KB).
usage.guide: Generate an image: POST to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-2/generate with JSON {"prompt": "...", "size": "1024x1024", "quality": "low|medium|high"} and pay via x402 (live cost ~$0.01 despite the $10 registry surface). The response gives you a jobId. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIWX authentication (free) every few seconds until body.status === "complete". Read the finished image from body.result.imageUrl, a public PNG URL.
